verdict: across the five query strings no screened item performs a same-target replay of a full-Internet snapshot against the live network across the four layers; the nearest works are single-layer, single-epoch comparisons or platform-machinery studies. The manuscript therefore keeps a 'to our knowledge' hedge and points at this record.
limitations: single bibliographic database (Crossref); title/venue/year screening only, no full-text review; the claim is scoped to what this search could establish, not to an exhaustive proof of absence.
